products.description: 该产品专用于治疗三叉神经痛等各种顽固性疼痛或椎间盘突出症。其与射频套管组合使用，并与射频治疗仪连接，输出射频电波作用于神经组织靶点进行热凝和神经调节或对椎间盘髓核组织进行消融，以有效通过配备转接线，可连接不同品牌的射频治仪。                                                                                    This product is specially designed for the treatment of various intractable pains such as trigeminal neuralgia or intervertebral disc herniation. It is used in combination with a radio‑frequency cannula and connected to a radio‑frequency therapeutic apparatus. It outputs radio‑frequency waves to act on target nerve tissues for thermocoagulation and nerve modulation, or ablate the nucleus pulposus tissue of intervertebral discs for effective treatment. Equipped with an adapter cable, it can be connected to radio‑frequency therapeutic apparatuses of different brands.

products.description: 该产品专用于治疗三叉神经痛等各种顽固性疼痛或椎间盘突出症。其与射频电极组合使用，经射频电极与射频治疗仪连接，输出射频电波作用于神经组织靶点进行热凝和神经调节或对椎间盘髓核组织进行消融，以有效通过配备转接线，可连接不同品牌的射频治仪。                                         特有的弯钝型头部结构适用于血管或神经较密集的区域的靶点穿刺。                                                                                                                    This product is specially designed for the treatment of various intractable pains such as trigeminal neuralgia or intervertebral disc herniation.Used in combination with RF electrode, connected to RF therapy unit via RF electrode It outputs radio‑frequency waves to act on target nerve tissues for thermocoagulation and nerve modulation, or ablate the nucleus pulposus tissue of intervertebral discs for effective treatment. Equipped with an adapter cable, it can be connected to radio‑frequency therapeutic apparatuses of different brands.                      Unique curved blunt tip for target puncture in vascular and nerve-dense regions.

products.description: 该产品专用于治疗三叉神经痛等各种顽固性疼痛或椎间盘突出症。其与射频电极组合使用，经射频电极与射频治疗仪连接，输出射频电波作用于神经组织靶点进行热凝和神经调节或对椎间盘髓核组织进行消融，以有效通过配备转接线，可连接不同品牌的射频治仪。                                    特有的弯尖侧孔型头部结构，可使电极前端从射频套管侧孔处穿出，与套管针尖构成“Y”形，适用于需实施较大区域热凝的靶点穿刺，可部分替代双针模式。                                                                                                  This product is specially designed for the treatment of various intractable pains such as trigeminal neuralgia or intervertebral disc herniation.Used in combination with RF electrode, connected to RF therapy unit via RF electrode It outputs radio‑frequency waves to act on target nerve tissues for thermocoagulation and nerve modulation, or ablate the nucleus pulposus tissue of intervertebral discs for effective treatment. Equipped with an adapter cable, it can be connected to radio‑frequency therapeutic apparatuses of different brands.                      The unique curved sharp tip with side port enables the electrode tip to exit through the side port of the RF cannula and form a "Y" configuration with the cannula tip for target puncture needing large-area thermocoagulation, partially replacing the double-needle mode.
